page.overview:
Who is Elrood III?

Emperor Elrood III was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 889–933 AG), succeeding his father Corrin III as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. In 912, a thousand years had passed since the Battle of Corrin (88 BG), when House Corrino seized power and founded the Imperium.

Elrood was succeeded in 933 by his grandson Wallach II.
